local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died approaching the original Kvatch gate after agreement')
 if math.abs(self.position.x)<10000 and math.abs(self.position.y)<10000 then
  print('KvatchEntry original interior reached position='..tostring(self.position)..' cell='..tostring(self.cell.name));return
 end
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 print('KvatchEntry control ready position='..tostring(self.position)..' cell='..tostring(self.cell.name))
 local gate=util.vector3(-144798.609375,-16498.912109375,11381.1650390625)
 local distance=(gate-self.position):length()
 local target=gate+util.vector3(0,0,130)
 local phase='gate'
 if distance>1400 then target=util.vector3(-145450,-17600,self.position.z+90);phase='flank' end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target)
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('KvatchEntry aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.3f phase=%s',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),distance,phase))
 if math.abs(ax)<.04 and math.abs(ay)<.06 then print('KvatchEntry facing ready') end
 if distance<180 then print('KvatchEntry near gate') end
 if distance<180 and math.abs(ax)<.03 and math.abs(ay)<.06 then print('KvatchEntry gate ready') end
end}}}}
